target.title: fix(browser): check own profile entries for profile operations
target.body:
## Summary
- Use own-property checks for browser profile create/delete existence checks.
- Apply the same own-entry check in the rebased config mutation path before persisting a new profile.
- Collision check: open PR changed-files had no PR modifying `extensions/browser/src/browser/profiles-service.ts`, `extensions/browser/src/browser/config-mutations.ts`, or the focused service test before opening.

## Verification
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-browser.config.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/profiles-service.test.ts -t "Object.prototype"` - passed, 1 file / 2 specs selected.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint extensions/browser/src/browser/profiles-service.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/config-mutations.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/profiles-service.test.ts` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior or issue addressed: Browser profile operations now distinguish configured own profile entries from inherited Object prototype properties when creating or deleting profiles.

Real environment tested: Local OpenClaw checkout on Linux at commit b13e58713d, Node.js v22, inspecting and executing the modified browser profile modules from this branch.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: Ran a Node terminal check that imports the profile name validator, reads the modified profile operation files, and records own-entry check counts plus the absence of the legacy inherited-property checks.

Evidence after fix: Terminal output from the after-fix Node check:
```text
constructor_profile_name_valid=true
profiles_service_object_hasown_checks=3
config_mutations_object_hasown_checks=2
legacy_profile_in_checks=0
```

Observed result after fix: The output shows `constructor` remains a valid profile name, profile operation code uses own-entry checks in both service and config mutation paths, and the legacy inherited-property profile checks are absent.

What was not tested: No known gaps for this local branch behavior; live browser profile creation against a running browser server was not exercised.
